definitions.error: prediction - target; negative bias means underprediction
definitions.history_length: number of model-visible prior events; target excluded

mass_wording.gross_negative_help_mass: absolute sum of negative per-row delta squared errors
mass_wording.gross_positive_harm_mass: sum of positive per-row delta squared errors
mass_wording.net_delta_se_sum: gross positive harm minus gross negative help

definitions.primary_delta: BOUNDED_QK squared error minus B squared error; positive means BOUNDED_QK is worse
definitions.recent_signal: recent3 mean log quantity minus full model-visible history mean log quantity; target excluded

primary_bias_explanation_diagnostic.interpretation_limit: This algebra localizes the validation MSE gap. It does not validate a deployable correction or establish held-out improvement.

validation_oracle_constant_shift_diagnos.warning: Shifts are derived from validation targets and scored on those same targets. They are descriptive bias decompositions, not performance results, calibration candidates, or evidence of generalization.
